title: Deep Grey Eyes
style: Winter festive pop with warm, husky smoky female mid-range vocals and an Australian accent; keyboards, 808, electric guitars, castanetes, and Christmas carol instrumental bridges; a steady pop groove; tight programmed drum mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Barcelona midday, customs on the plane
Rode with Claire to Barceloneta, Thomas went his way
Christmas Eve reception, free day in the city
Sagrada Família, getting dressed up pretty

[Pre-Chorus]
Then I walked in and saw her standing next to him
Easy, comfortable, more friends than anything

[Chorus]
And there she was with deep grey eyes
I couldn't look away, I stared too long, I blew it twice
But she took my hand beneath the table, whispered low
"I don't do hookups, only friends" — and wouldn't let it go

[Verse 2]
Sylvia walked me over, said her name before I asked
Erika Czajka, Swedish-Polish, not the questions that I passed
Biologist in Utrecht, skater close to national team
By the party's ending, she knew everything about me

[Pre-Chorus]
She followed me upstairs, we kept talking, kissing, more
Woke on Christmas morning to those eyes I'd seen before

[Chorus]
And there she was with deep grey eyes
"Hello, friend," she said, and I was hypnotized
She took my hand beneath the table, whispered low
"I don't do hookups, only friends" — and wouldn't let it go

[Bridge]
Barcelona to London, New Year's Eve together
Left for Utrecht on the fifth, said this was something better
But she insists upon the word, no adjectives attached
No "just," no "special," no "girl"—just friendship, and that's that

[Final Chorus]
And there she was with deep grey eyes
Not a girlfriend, not a lover, something she defines
She took my hand beneath the table, whispered low
"I don't do hookups, only friends" — and I said okay, let's go

[Outro]
No special friend, no girlfriend
Just the word she chose
My friend Erika
And those deep grey eyes I know
